name: Elephant Status manipulable sweep pricing
summary: Permissionless sweep() sized and executed a zero-minimum-output Treasury-funded buyback from live PancakeSwap reserves, so the attacker skewed the BUSD/WBNB spot price, triggered the buyback against that price, reversed the trade, and retained the spread.
notes: The direct Elephant Status runtime was created in this transaction and remained byte-identical through the pre-exploit block; no target-originated delegatecall or later code-selection event appears before or during the exploit.

Net loss is the exact BUSD transfer from the attack helper to the attacker EOA after four flash-loan principals and fees were repaid; both attacker and helper started with zero BUSD and the helper ended with zero. The Treasury lost 193,627.110417113639371428 BUSD to the manipulated buyback, but the transaction also acquired and burned fee-on-transfer ELEPHANT and paid pool fees, so the vulnerability-attributable gross depletion cannot be isolated without a counterfactual price. The conservative onchain net is valued at par.
